official_organization_description: Repositório do Portal do Software Público Brasileiro
scope_caveat: This is a snapshot of the current public spbgovbr GitHub organization. Official government documentation describes it as a mix of projects from the new portal and PEN modules; it is not a complete or inferable enumeration of the historical catalog said to contain 81 items.
historic_catalog_access: The official Catálogo Antigo link targets https://softwarepublico.gov.br/social/search/software_infos; it returned HTTP 403 during this investigation. The documented public GitLab project listing and GitLab API were also inaccessible from the runtime.
